**gbrain didn't work:** Every search was refused because this bot's gbrain token isn't linked to a member. Nothing was read from it, so this answer comes only from what Dana can see herself. Because this is a shared bot, the better option is `--may-act-for` with the members' names, so each request can name the person it's for. I didn't attempt the fix myself.
